props.name: mainClassName
props.description: Class name for the main container element.

props.name: frontFaceClassName
props.description: Class name for the front face element.

props.name: secondFaceClassName
props.description: Class name for the secondary face element.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: X Padding to add around the text content for the box (in pixels)

props.description: Duration of stagger delay between elements in seconds.

props.description: Fixed width for each character box (optional)

props.name: charHeight
props.description: Fixed height for each character box (optional)
